name: Levi Casey
bio: a Representative from South Carolina; born in South Carolina about 1752; served in the Revolutionary War in the Continental Army; elected brigadier general of militia; justice of Newberry County Court in 1785; member of the South Carolina state senate, 1781-1782 and 1800-1802; member of the South Carolina state house of representatives, 1786-1788, 1792-1795 and 1798-1799; elected as a Democratic Republican to the Eighth and Ninth Congresses and served from March 4, 1803, until his death, before the close of the Ninth Congress; had been reelected to the Tenth Congress; died in Washington, D.C., February 3, 1807; interment in the Congressional Cemetery.
